# fireworks_supervised_fine_tuning_job (Resource)

A supervised fine-tuning job. Jobs run asynchronously and are immutable; changes force replacement. Running a job incurs training costs on your Fireworks account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fireworks_supervised_fine_tuning_job" "tune" {
  display_name = "llama tune v1"
  base_model   = "accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct"
  dataset      = fireworks_dataset.training.name

  epochs        = 2
  learning_rate = 0.0001
  lora_rank     = 16
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dataset` (String) Training dataset, e.g. accounts/my-account/datasets/my-dataset.

### Optional

- `base_model` (String) Base model to fine-tune, e.g. accounts/fireworks/models/llama-v3p1-8b-instruct. Exactly one of base_model or warm_start_from must be set.
- `batch_size` (Number) Training batch size.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `early_stop` (Boolean) Stop training early when evaluation loss stops improving.
- `epochs` (Number) Number of training epochs.
- `evaluation_dataset` (String) Dataset used for evaluation during training.
- `learning_rate` (Number) Learning rate.
- `lora_rank` (Number) LoRA rank.
- `max_context_length` (Number) Maximum context length used during training.
- `output_model` (String) Name for the resulting model. Generated by the API when omitted.
- `warm_start_from` (String) Existing fine-tuned model to continue training from. Exactly one of base_model or warm_start_from must be set.

### Read-Only

- `completed_time` (String) Completion timestamp (RFC 3339), empty while the job is running.
- `create_time` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Job ID (last segment of the resource name).
- `name` (String) Full resource name, e.g. accounts/my-account/supervisedFineTuningJobs/abc123.
- `state` (String) Job state (JOB_STATE_CREATING, JOB_STATE_RUNNING, JOB_STATE_COMPLETED, JOB_STATE_FAILED, JOB_STATE_CANCELLED).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import fireworks_supervised_fine_tuning_job.tune <job-id>
```
